key_insight: LoRA dynamics differ by training stage: RL concentrates singular spectra and rotates subspaces faster at small learning rates, with group-mean baseline subtraction driving both contrasts with SFT.
engineering_relevance: Stage-specific LoRA updates may improve mathematical reasoning by spreading adaptation across singular directions in SFT and promoting subspace rotation in RL.
method: Track LoRA update spectra and singular subspaces during SFT and RL.
Isolate training ingredients and explain baseline subtraction effects using a quadratic multi-index model.
Flatten full-update spectra for SFT; flatten the component outside the current LoRA increment span for RL.
evidence_signal: Across multiple models on mathematical reasoning tasks, the respective SFT and RL configurations perform best among compared methods in most evaluated settings.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify gains or computational overhead, and generalization beyond mathematical reasoning remains unestablished.
paper_title: Spectral and Subspace Dynamics of LoRA in Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning
